visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In 2019, an outdoor snowy landscape with bare trees in the background shows a man in a neon yellow ski jacket and red beanie struggling to balance on skis. An instructor in a green camouflage jacket supports his arm as they move slowly on flat, icy terrain under bright natural daylight. (2) In 2022, inside an indoor skiing facility with white walls and artificial snow, the man, now wearing a black helmet and face mask, practices snowboarding. He maintains a crouched posture, looking focused yet slightly unstable as he slides across the flat surface. (3) In 2023, on an expansive outdoor ski slope with distant mountains, the man snowboards down a hill. He successfully executes turns while wearing a beige jacket and black helmet before eventually falling into the soft snow in a medium shot. (4) In 2024, the man snowboards through deep powder in a wooded area, shown from a dynamic follow-shot perspective. He falls but laughs, and is later seen sitting on the slope with a friend, both wearing full safety gear and goggles. (5) In 2025, during a snowy night at a parking area, a group of three friends waves excitedly at the camera. The main character then appears in a close-up, proudly holding up a yellow instructor certification badge while grinning broadly at the lens. (6) In the final scene, the man is indoors in a black t-shirt, speaking directly to the camera with high energy. He gestures with his hands in front of a computer desk and monitor setup under bright indoor lighting.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: An Asian man with short dark hair, seen in various winter sports outfits including a neon yellow jacket and red beanie, and finally in a casual black t-shirt.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: Outdoor ski slopes with lifts and trees, an indoor ski training facility, a parking lot at night with snow, and a home office with a computer desk.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a light acoustic guitar melody and natural wind noise. A male voice speaks with high energy and moderate pitch, discussing the difficulty of stopping on skis. The sound of sliding on icy snow is audible in the outdoor recording. (2) A sudden sharp scream 'Ahhh' from the man interrupts as the scene shifts to an indoor facility. The acoustic texture changes to a reverberant room tone with a faint mechanical hum, reflecting the enclosed space and different activity. (3) During the 2023 outdoor section, vocal arousal increases significantly. A companion shouts '轉了' (turned) with excitement. The music remains upbeat, and the rhythmic carving sound of a snowboard through snow is prominent before a muffled thud occurs. (4) A group of friends in 2025 shouts 'Bye Bye Andy' and '後會有期' with very high positive valence and joy. The sound of heavy wind is heard over the crunching of snow. The music swells as the main character expresses his pride in becoming an instructor. (5) The final segment features a clean, studio-quality recording of the main character speaking. His voice is authoritative yet friendly, with fast delivery and rising intonations as he encourages viewers to check out his upcoming video content.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents the creator's persistent journey from a clumsy beginner in 2019 to becoming a certified snowboarding instructor in 2025. It serves as both an inspiring personal growth vlog and a teaser for a detailed video scheduled for Monday at 9 PM.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Consistent presence of the travel agency logo '亞鴻假期' (Yahong Holidays) in the corner during travel segments.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A highly engaging montage-style vlog that effectively uses year-by-year comparisons to show professional improvement in a niche hobby.
